Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 89. Category: form. Ancient Super Saiyan.

Transformation
The ancient saiyan’s more powerful version of super
Saiyan, the Saiyan’s eyes turn a shining emerald, and
their hair spikes up and turns such a deep gold it
appears to be solid gold. Their aura is enough to levitate
small rocks.
Increase your Power by 1
Increase your Movement Speed by 10 ft.
You deal an additional 1d6 to all damage
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
